provenance: Authored from the twelve canonical taxonomy names before running the unified candidate-pair experiment. No validation/test review text, gold labels, predictions, or error analysis was consulted.

negative.definition: The writer expresses a complaint, problem, dissatisfaction, criticism, or an unfavourable judgement about this aspect.

neutral.definition: The writer mentions this aspect factually, ambiguously, or with mixed information but without a clearly favourable or unfavourable judgement.

positive.definition: The writer expresses praise, satisfaction, approval, recommendation, or a favourable judgement about this aspect.

Account management: Account access.definition: Accessing or regaining access to a customer account, including signing in, passwords, registration, verification, locked accounts, and account credentials.
Account management: Account access.boundary: Do not use this aspect merely because support was contacted by phone or email; the review must discuss account access itself.

Company brand: Competitor.definition: Another company, provider, brand, or alternative is named, compared, preferred, considered, or used as a substitute for the focal company.
Company brand: Competitor.boundary: General satisfaction with the focal company is not enough unless an alternative company or provider is discussed.

Company brand: General satisfaction.definition: An overall judgement of the company, service, or complete customer experience rather than a judgement limited to one operational feature.
Company brand: General satisfaction.boundary: Use a more specific operational aspect when the judgement is clearly limited to access, price, speed, staff, app, booking, discounts, phone, email, or reviews.

Company brand: Reviews.definition: Customer reviews, ratings, testimonials, reputation feedback, or the act of reading, leaving, requesting, or responding to a review.
Company brand: Reviews.boundary: A reviewer's own general opinion is not automatically about the Reviews aspect; the content must discuss reviews or ratings as an object.

Logistics rides: Speed.definition: How quickly or slowly a journey, ride, delivery, collection, or logistics service happens, including delays, waiting time, and punctuality.
Logistics rides: Speed.boundary: Ease of booking or staff responsiveness is separate unless the review discusses the elapsed speed of the logistics or ride service.

Online experience: App website.definition: Using the mobile app, website, webpage, online portal, or digital interface, including navigation, loading, crashes, bugs, and online functionality.
Online experience: App website.boundary: Account access and the booking process are separate when the problem is specifically credentials or the transaction workflow rather than the digital channel generally.

Purchase booking experience: Ease of use.definition: How easy, difficult, clear, or convenient it is to purchase, order, reserve, book, check out, or complete the customer transaction workflow.
Purchase booking experience: Ease of use.boundary: App or website performance alone is not enough unless it affects the ease of completing a purchase or booking.

Staff support: Attitude of staff.definition: The behaviour, manner, helpfulness, friendliness, rudeness, professionalism, knowledge, or empathy of employees and support staff.
Staff support: Attitude of staff.boundary: Phone and email are contact channels; use this aspect when the judgement concerns the people or their manner.

Staff support: Email.definition: Customer contact or support through email, including sending messages, replies, response time, missing responses, and the quality of an email exchange.
Staff support: Email.boundary: A judgement about staff attitude without an email exchange belongs to Attitude of staff; telephone calls belong to Phone.

Staff support: Phone.definition: Customer contact or support by telephone, including calls, call centres, being on hold, callbacks, answering, and telephone conversations.
Staff support: Phone.boundary: Email exchanges belong to Email; staff manner can additionally be Attitude of staff when the review explicitly judges the person.

Value: Discounts promotions.definition: Discounts, promotions, promotional offers, coupons, vouchers, sales, special deals, loyalty offers, or advertised price reductions.
Value: Discounts promotions.boundary: Ordinary price or value-for-money comments without a specific offer or reduction belong to Price value for money.

Value: Price value for money.definition: The ordinary price, cost, charge, fee, affordability, expensiveness, cheapness, or whether the service is worth what the customer paid.
Value: Price value for money.boundary: A specific coupon, sale, promotion, or advertised reduction belongs to Discounts promotions.
